search_metadata.evidence_digest:
NAME AND CROP CHECK
Variety name used: Divya (BAU-06-03). Seednet name: DIVYA. Crop: linseed. The Seednet crop field says "PADDY (DHAN)", and no source found links Divya to paddy. Paddy and other "Divya" results were discarded: Kalash Seeds paddy Divya -- https://www.kalashseeds.com/products/paddy/divya.php ; IIRR rice Divya (1989) -- https://icar-iirr.org/IIRR%20NL%20Apr_June_2015.pdf ; Divya F1 sponge gourd -- https://www.eastwestseed.com/variety/divya-f1/
Searches run: 4 of 4. The Seednet portal itself was not retrieved, so no Seednet record was found under either name.

STRESS TOLERANCE
Listed as resistant to rust, Alternaria blight, wilt and bud fly -- https://oilseeds.dac.gov.in/Linseed.aspx
Described as resistant to multiple diseases and pests (IAUA news, BAU release) -- http://www.iauaindia.org/publications/PUB_637852580202036105.pdf
Drought, heat, salinity, flood, submergence: No evidence found for this variety. Searches returned no variety-specific source.

DISEASE AND PEST
Rust, Alternaria blight, wilt, bud fly resistance (as listed above) -- https://oilseeds.dac.gov.in/Linseed.aspx
Multiple disease and pest resistance (as above) -- http://www.iauaindia.org/publications/PUB_637852580202036105.pdf
Disease reaction ratings from artificial and natural conditions: No evidence found for Divya specifically. The AICRP linseed release table covers other linseed varieties only in the retrieved text -- https://aicrp.icar.gov.in/linseed/varieties-released/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Oil content 39.81% with about 60% omega-3 fatty acid, average yield 15.4 q/ha, potential yield 21.15 q/ha, maturity 127-130 days -- https://bauranchi.org/bau-releases-high-yielding-seeds-after-years-long-research/
Same release page also gives an earlier paragraph (14.9 q/ha, 112-120 days) that is not clearly tied to Divya; treat as ambiguous -- https://bauranchi.org/bau-releases-high-yielding-seeds-after-years-long-research/
The IAUA news repeats 15.4 q/ha average and 21.15 q/ha potential -- http://www.iauaindia.org/publications/PUB_637852580202036105.pdf
DOD record gives yield potential as 39.81 kg/ha and oil as "1538 (I)" / "815 (R)". These values are garbled and conflict with the BAU figures; not used -- https://oilseeds.dac.gov.in/Linseed.aspx
Multi-location trial results: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL
Parentage WGL 23022/SUREKHA: No evidence found. A "Surekha" hit (IIRR rice) was discarded.
QTL or marker studies: No evidence found.
Combining ability: A diallel study names a parent "Divya" (linseed). It is not shown to be this variety, so it is excluded -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/331542067_Diallel_Analysis_for_Estimation_of_Combining_Ability_for_Seed_Yield_and_It's_Component_Traits_in_Linseed_Linum_usitatissimum_L

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developing institution: Birsa Agricultural University (BAU), Ranchi; release centre listed as Kanke -- https://oilseeds.dac.gov.in/Linseed.aspx
BAU released Divya (BAU-06-03) and Priyam (BAU-2012-1) as linseed varieties -- https://bauranchi.org/achievements/
Release by the Jharkhand State Variety Release Committee, with three linseed varieties in the batch (Divya is named on the BAU release page above) -- https://bauranchi.org/bau-releases-high-yielding-seeds-after-years-long-research/
Lead breeder name(s): No evidence found. Searches returned no breeder name for this variety.
Mismatch note: the central DOD record and the CSC metadata give 2016, while the BAU/Jharkhand state release coverage is dated around August 2021 -- https://www.drishtiias.com/state-pcs-current-affairs/birsa-agricultural-university

CONTACT DETAILS
Institute: Birsa Agricultural University, Kanke, Ranchi - 834006, Jharkhand, India -- https://bauranchi.org/contact-us/
Institute phones: +91-651-2450832 and +91-651-2450850 -- https://bauranchi.org/contact-us/
Vice Chancellor's office email (VC office, institute-level): vc@bauranchi.org; VC phone 0651-2450500, 2450777 -- https://www.indiacustomercare.com/birsa-agricultural-university-contact-no-0651-245-0832 (third-party listing; check against the official site)
Dean, Faculty of Agriculture, Ranchi (institute-level, not a breeder): Dr. D. K. Shahi, phone 9431371709, email dksbau@gmail.com and deanagrilbau@gmail.com -- https://bauranchi.org/contact-us/

drought.details: DRH 775 is recognized as a short-duration, drought-tolerant rice hybrid suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions. It is tolerant to general water stress.

heat.details: This hybrid is identified as heat tolerant in nature and is suitable for yield enhancement under heat stress conditions. It has also shown a significant yield advantage in trials aimed at identifying heat-tolerant rice genotypes.

salinity.details: DRH 775 is listed among rice hybrids tolerant to abiotic stress conditions, which includes salinity. One source explicitly mentions it in the context of drought and salt tolerance in rice research.

flood.details: It exhibits tolerance to water logging and is listed among varieties tolerant to flash floods and stagnant flooding conditions, particularly relevant for direct-seeded rice (DSR).

disease_resistance.summary: DRH 775 is reported to be highly resistant to Gall Midge (GM).

pest_resistance.summary: Not specified beyond Gall Midge resistance.

agronomic_details.yield: Reported yields vary, including 60-65 Quintals per hectare (6.0-6.5 t/ha), 7.7 tons per hectare in Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and 4.77 tons per hectare with a significant yield advantage over regional checks. In Nepal, yields of 5.6 t/ha have been noted.
agronomic_details.stability: DRH 775 has demonstrated a significant yield advantage over check varieties and is broadly adapted due to its tolerance to a wide range of abiotic stresses.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Suitable for irrigated areas, direct sown rainfed conditions, and aerobic cultivation. In Nepal, it is adapted to Tarai and inner Tarai regions.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf (approximately 82 cm plant height) with long slender (LS) grains. It is also noted as non-lodging.
agronomic_details.field_trials: The variety has been included in monitoring reports for the 'Bringing Green Revolution to Eastern India' program, indicating widespread evaluation and promotion. It has also shown significant yield advantage over checks in various trials and evaluations for stress tolerance.

drought.details: DRRH-4 was released for aerobic (direct-seeded, water-limited) ecosystems, which is the only stress-related suitability stated for this hybrid. No drought score or drought trial result for DRRH-4 was found. The authors note that most released rice hybrids are sensitive to high-temperature and drought stress, which motivated aerobic hybrid breeding; this is context only and not a tested result for DRRH-4. The DRR Dhan 44 (IET 22081) drought results found in the search belong to a different variety and were excluded.

heat.details: No heat tolerance score or heat trial result for DRRH-4 was found. High-temperature sensitivity of most released hybrids is mentioned only as background context for the aerobic hybrid breeding programme, not as a tested result for DRRH-4.

salinity.details: Not found in searched sources. The DRR Dhan 58 salinity study retrieved concerns another genotype and was excluded. The Saltol-related items retrieved concern other materials and were discarded.

flood.details: Not found in searched sources. No flood tolerance score for DRRH-4 was found.

disease_resistance.summary: Moderate resistance to leaf blast and neck blast is reported for DRRH-4 (IET 27937). ICAR-IIRR lists DRRH-4 as an aerobic rice hybrid with multiple resistance, but the page gives no per-disease detail. Bacterial leaf blight and other diseases: Not found in searched sources. The blast and bacterial leaf blight data found for DRR Dhan 44 belong to a different variety and were excluded.

pest_resistance.summary: Moderate resistance to gall midge, rice stem borer and whorl maggot is reported for DRRH-4 (IET 27937). ICAR-IIRR's listing states multiple resistance without per-pest detail. No other pest reactions were found.

agronomic_details.yield: Mean grain yield of 5030 kg/ha across the five states, which is 32%, 28%, 22% and 11% above the national, zonal, local and hybrid checks respectively. State-wise weighted mean yield was 5306 kg/ha, 14% above the best check. Up to 5.5-6.0 t/ha is reported under suitable conditions.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources. Yield was reported across five states in multi-location trials, but no stability statistic or genotype-by-environment analysis appears in the digest.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Released for aerobic (direct-seeded, water-limited) ecosystems. Evaluated and recommended for Punjab, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Tripura and Gujarat.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: About 120 days seed to seed. Another copy of the paper gives 115-120 days versus transplanted rice.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Grain and milling quality: hulling 79.2%, milling 71.3%, head rice recovery 62.8%. Long bold grain with KL 6.5 mm and KB 2.4 mm. Other morphological characteristics: Not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.field_trials: DRRH-4 was evaluated in AICRIP multi-location aerobic trials in wet seasons 2018 to 2021 and nominated in the AICRIP aerobic trial of 2018. Mean grain yield across the five states was 5030 kg/ha, with 32%, 28%, 22% and 11% advantages over national, zonal, local and hybrid checks. The state-wise weighted mean was 5306 kg/ha, 14% above the best check, across Punjab, Odisha, Tripura, Chhattisgarh and Gujarat. Trial results for other varieties (DRR Dhan 44) were excluded.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources. No marker-assisted or SSR/SNP study specific to DRRH-4 was found.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: Not found in searched sources. No QTL study specific to DRRH-4 was found. Genomic-prediction and Saltol items retrieved concern other materials and were discarded.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: Not found in searched sources. Parentage is reported as APMS-6A / AR 9-18 (breeding designation IIRRH-124), developed as a hybrid of this cross.

This is a cooperative society, not identified as a government seed corporation in the digest.

STRESS TOLERANCE
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Released for aerobic (direct-seeded, water-limited) ecosystems, which is the only stress-related suitability stated for this hybrid; no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence score for DRRH-4 was found. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375060794_DRRH-4_IET_27937_-World's_First_Public_Bred_Aerobic_Rice_Hybrid
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Its aerobic-rice background is framed against abiotic stress: the authors note that most released rice hybrids are sensitive to high-temperature and drought stress, which motivated aerobic hybrid breeding (this is context, not a tested result for DRRH-4). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375060794_DRRH-4_IET_27937_-World's_First_Public_Bred_Aerobic_Rice_Hybrid
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this heading. The DRR Dhan 44 (IET 22081) drought and water-limited results found belong to a different variety with the same "DRR 44" label and were discarded: https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/33-iirr-technologies/105-technology-3

DISEASE AND PEST
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Shows moderate resistance to leaf blast, neck blast, gall midge, rice stem borer and whorl maggot. -- https://sarr.co.in/2023/09/05/drrh-4-iet-27937-worlds-first-public-bred-aerobic-rice-hybrid/
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Listed by ICAR-IIRR as an aerobic rice hybrid with multiple resistance (no per-disease detail on that page). -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this variety. The blast and bacterial leaf blight data found refer to DRR Dhan 44, a different variety: https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Maturity: about 120 days seed to seed; another copy of the paper gives 115-120 days versus transplanted rice. -- https://sarr.co.in/wp-content/uploads/DRRH-4-IET-27937-Worlds-First-Public-13.pdf
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Yield: mean grain yield of 5030 kg/ha across the five states, 32%, 28%, 22% and 11% above national, zonal, local and hybrid checks; up to 5.5-6.0 t/ha reported under suitable conditions. -- https://sarr.co.in/wp-content/uploads/DRRH-4-IET-27937-Worlds-First-Public-13.pdf
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] State-wise weighted mean yield was 5306 kg/ha (14% above the best check) across Punjab, Odisha, Tripura, Chhattisgarh and Gujarat. -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Yield-performance-of-DRRH-4-in-Punjab-Odisha-Tripura-Chhattisgarh-and-Gujarat-states_tbl1_375060794
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Grain and milling quality: hulling 79.2%, milling 71.3%, head rice recovery 62.8%; long bold grain (KL 6.5 mm, KB 2.4 mm). -- https://sarr.co.in/wp-content/uploads/DRRH-4-IET-27937-Worlds-First-Public-13.pdf ; https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Yield-performance-of-DRRH-4-in-Punjab-Odisha-Tripura-Chhattisgarh-and-Gujarat-states_tbl1_375060794
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Testing: evaluated in AICRIP multi-location aerobic trials in wet seasons 2018 to 2021, and nominated in the AICRIP aerobic trial of 2018. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375060794_DRRH-4_IET_27937_-World's_First_Public_Bred_Aerobic_Rice_Hybrid
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Release context: ICAR-IIRR reports DRRH 4 was among four hybrids released in kharif 2022-23 through CVRC, described as the world's first aerobic rice hybrid. -- https://icar-iirr.org/58%20ARGM%20Final%20Draft%20Proceedings15-09-2023.pdf
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this variety. Yield, maturity and trial data found for DRR Dhan 44 (IET 22081; 2014 release; Uttarakhand, Haryana, Bihar) were discarded: https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/33-iirr-technologies/105-technology-3

GENETICS AND QTL
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Parentage: developed from the cross APMS-6A / AR 9-18 (breeding designation IIRRH-124). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375060794_DRRH-4_IET_27937_-World's_First_Public_Bred_Aerobic_Rice_Hybrid
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] No QTL, marker-assisted or genomic study specific to DRRH-4 was found. The genomic-prediction and Saltol items retrieved concern other materials and were discarded.
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this variety.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Lead author and corresponding author: Senguttuvel P, Senior Scientist, ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375060794_DRRH-4_IET_27937_-World's_First_Public_Bred_Aerobic_Rice_Hybrid
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Co-authors: Hari Prasad AS, Sundaram RM, Revathi P, Kemparaju KB, Sruthi K, Subba Rao LV (all ICAR-IIRR). -- https://sarr.co.in/wp-content/uploads/DRRH-4-IET-27937-Worlds-First-Public-13.pdf
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] A.S. Hariprasad, Principal Scientist and Head of the Hybrid Rice section, presented the hybrid trial report at ICAR-IIRR; this links him to the hybrid programme, not expressly to DRRH-4's development. -- https://icar-iirr.org/58%20ARGM%20Final%20Draft%20Proceedings15-09-2023.pdf
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Developing institution: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500030. -- https://sarr.co.in/wp-content/uploads/DRRH-4-IET-27937-Worlds-First-Public-13.pdf
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this variety. The "developed by IIRR under STRASA" statements retrieved refer to DRR Dhan 44: https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/33-iirr-technologies/105-technology-3

CONTACT DETAILS
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Corresponding author: Senguttuvel P, email as printed in the paper: senguttuvel@gmail.com (this appears to be a personal address, not an official institute address). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/375060794_DRRH-4_IET_27937_-World's_First_Public_Bred_Aerobic_Rice_Hybrid
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Institute postal address: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500030, India. -- https://sarr.co.in/wp-content/uploads/DRRH-4-IET-27937-Worlds-First-Public-13.pdf
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Institute website (institute-level contact page): https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/?option=com_content&view=article&id=176 . No official phone number or official institute email was found in the results.
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this variety.

PUBLICATIONS
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Senguttuvel P, Hari Prasad AS, Sundaram RM, Revathi P, Kemparaju KB, Sruthi K, Subba Rao LV (2023). DRRH-4 (IET 27937) - World's First Public Bred Aerobic Rice Hybrid. Journal of Rice Research 16(1):105-106 -- DOI 10.58297/KCIX9658 (https://doi.org/10.58297/KCIX9658)
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] Author list for the ICAR-IIRR AICRIP Annual Group Meeting draft proceedings (2023) is not fully visible in the retrieved text; the item records the DRRH 4 release report. -- https://icar-iirr.org/58%20ARGM%20Final%20Draft%20Proceedings15-09-2023.pdf
[DRR-44 / Seednet name] No evidence found for this variety. Other papers retrieved (DRR Dhan 58 salinity study, DOI 10.1186/s12284-022-00591-3; Senguttuvel 64-hybrid genetics study) concern other genotypes and were discarded.
KrishiKosh / thesis search: No evidence found in these results.

SEED AVAILABILITY
[DRRH-4 / IET 27937] ICAR-IIRR signed a technology licence agreement with Krishi Vikas Sahakari Samiti Ltd for large-scale seed production and popularisation of DRRH 4. -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/?option=com_content&view=article&id=176

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: DRRH-3 (CSC name) / DRRH-1 (Seednet name), rice

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Parent DRRH3 is highly susceptible to bacterial blight and blast, which limit its productivity; no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data for DRRH-3 were found -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13562-016-0352-z
- Restorer line RPHR-1005 (male parent) was improved by marker-assisted backcrossing for bacterial blight and blast resistance; improved versions kept medium-slender grain and yield equal to or better than DRRH3 -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13562-016-0352-z
- Seednet name (DRRH-1): no stress data found. The DRRH 1 record in the hybrid lists (1996, 7.30 t/ha, Andhra Pradesh) refers to a different hybrid -- https://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Hybrid-Rice-Varieties.htm

DISEASE AND PEST
- DRRH3 is highly susceptible to bacterial blight (BB) and blast -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13562-016-0352-z
- Xa21 (BB) and Pi54 (blast) were introgressed into RPHR-1005, the male parent, by marker-assisted backcross breeding, giving BB and blast resistance in derived hybrids -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13562-016-0352-z
- Earlier MABB work pyramided BB and gall midge resistance genes into RPHR-1005 -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12041-016-0711-5
- Insect pest and disease scores for DRRH-3 itself: No evidence found

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Release record: DRRH-3 (IET 19543), year 2010, duration 131 days, yield 6.07 t/ha, developed by DRR Hyderabad -- https://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Hybrid-Rice-Varieties.htm
- Same hybrid listed as 2009 release with 6.07 t/ha and 131 days -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/263920493_HYBRID_RICE_DEVELOPMENT_TWO_LINE_AND_THREE_LINE_SYSTEM
- DRRH3 is listed among early-duration hybrids and among medium-slender (MS) grain hybrids -- https://www.intechopen.com/chapters/73489
- Multi-location trial data, plot yields, and agronomic practices for DRRH-3: No evidence found

GENETICS AND QTL
- Parentage given in the input (IR 58025A/IR40750-82-2-2-3R): No evidence found. Parentage of the hybrid was not confirmed in any retrieved source.
- Male parent (restorer) is RPHR-1005, which carries fertility restoration genes Rf3 and Rf4 -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13562-016-0352-z
- Xa21 + Pi54 introgression into RPHR-1005 by MABB; QTL/marker details listed in the Springer abstract -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13562-016-0352-z
- Earlier BB and gall midge gene pyramiding in RPHR-1005 -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12041-016-0711-5
- Heterosis and SSR-based genetic purity for hybrids (general hybrid work, not DRRH-3-specific) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/344590554_Hybrid_Rice_Research_Current_Status_and_Prospects

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: Directorate of Rice Research (DRR), ICAR, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad (now ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, IIRR) -- https://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Hybrid-Rice-Varieties.htm ; https://www.indiamart.com/directorate-rice-research/aboutus.html
- Lead breeder name for DRRH-3: No evidence found. E. A. Siddiq is credited with DRRH-1 (not DRRH-3) as Project Director of DRR -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E._A._Siddiq
- Station: Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500030 -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute: Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR), Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500 030, India -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us
- Director email (as listed): director.iirr@icar.gov.in -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us
- Tel: -91-40-24591285; Fax: +91-40-24591217; PD Cell: 91-40-24591218; Administration: 91-40-24591257/256; PMEC: 91-40-24591241 -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us
- Older DRR listing: email pdrice@drricar.org; Tel +91 40 245 91217; website www.drricar.org -- https://www.asti.cgiar.org/node/2036
- Breeder-level contact: No evidence found. (A personal Gmail address for SARR's secretary, Dr. R. M. Kumar, appears at https://sarr.co.in/home/contact-us/. This is a society contact, not an official institute contact, so it is not recommended.)

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: DRR-1 (CSC release name) / DRRH-1 (Seednet name)

Name note: No source I found uses "DRR-1" as a variety name. Every match for the parentage IR58025A/IR40750 and the public hybrid named DRRH-1 (IIRR, Hyderabad). The evidence below therefore refers to DRRH-1, the Seednet name. Its parentage matches the input record. The CSC release-minute name "DRR-1" is unverified.

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found. Searches returned no stress-tolerance data for DRRH-1 or its cross. Stress-tolerance results in the searches concerned other varieties (for example DRR Dhan 42 and DRR Dhan 58). -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed?layout=edit&id=104 (drought data is for DRR Dhan 42, not DRRH-1)

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found. No blast, bacterial blight, sheath blight or insect reaction data for DRRH-1 was returned. The parent IR58025A is described as a CMS line with stable sterility, not as a resistance source. -- https://www.fao.org/4/w8595t/w8595t02.htm

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- DRRH-1 was released in 1996 with a duration of 125-130 days. On-farm yield was 7.30 t/ha against a check of 5.50 t/ha, a 37.4% advantage (in West Bengal OFT table). A second table gives 32.7% over Tellahamsa, Andhra Pradesh. The two tables differ on the check and the state. -- https://www.fao.org/4/y3544e/y3544e04.htm ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/254371430_Rice_in_India_Present_Status_and_Strategies_to_Boost_Its_Production_Through_Hybrids ; https://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Hybrid-Rice-Varieties.htm

GENETICS AND QTL -- Cross recorded as IR58025A/IR40750 (CMS female IR58025A, male restorer IR40750), per the public hybrid release table. IR58025A is an IRRI-bred CMS line, stable in sterility in tropical conditions. No QTL or marker study for DRRH-1 was found. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/254371430_Rice_in_India_Present_Status_and_Strategies_to_Boost_Its_Production_Through_Hybrids ; https://www.fao.org/4/w8595t/w8595t02.htm

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
DRR DHAN 41 (variety_name) / DRR DHAN-47 (seednet_variety_name), rice

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found. The searches returned pages on DRR Dhan 42, 44 and 58 (drought and salinity), but none names DRR Dhan 41 or DRR Dhan 47.

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found for DRR Dhan 41 or DRR Dhan 47. A search for the variety name returned a page on DRR Dhan 42 and 44 with blast and bacterial blight reactions, which I discarded as other varieties (https://rkbassam.aau.ac.in/stress-tolerant-rice-varieties).

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- No evidence found. The only trial result returned concerns DRR Dhan 58, a different variety (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/).

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found for DRR Dhan 41 or DRR Dhan 47. The DRR Dhan 58 paper (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/) describes Saltol and bacterial blight genes in a different variety, so I did not attribute it here.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- No evidence found. The DRR prefix suggests ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Hyderabad, but no page I retrieved links DRR Dhan 41 or 47 to IIRR or to any breeder. This is an unverified inference from the name, not a finding.

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder contact found. Institute-level contact for ICAR-IIRR, which is not confirmed as this variety's developer:
- Dr. R. M. Sundaram, Director, ICAR-IIRR (publication contact) -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/Technologies/Innovative%20Technologies.pdf
- Email: director.iirr@icar.gov.in -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/Technologies/Innovative%20Technologies.pdf
- Tel: +91-40-24591218; Fax: +91-40-24591217 -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/Technologies/Innovative%20Technologies.pdf
- Address: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad – 500030, Telangana, India -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/Technologies/Innovative%20Technologies.pdf

PUBLICATIONS -- No evidence found for DRR Dhan 41 or DRR Dhan 47. Unrelated items returned: a zinc-biofortification study on DRR Dhan-42 and DRR Dhan-48 (https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Unfortified-DRR-Dhan-42-and-zinc-biofortified-DRR-Dhan-48-rice-varieties-in-paddy_fig1_387106074) and the DRR Dhan 58 paper (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/). Neither is about this variety.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found. The seed-availability search was not run, because the search budget was reached. The seednet portal was not searched directly.

RECOMMENDED STATES -- No evidence found. The variety's recommended states were not stated in any retrieved page. Recommendations for DRR Dhan 42 and others are not transferable.

Search log: three searches returned results (variety name, breeder/institute, exact name "DRR Dhan 41"). One parallel batch of five queries failed with a server tool-use limit, so the search budget may have been used up earlier than planned. search_metadata.evidence_digest:
DRR Dhan 43 (CSC name) -- evidence refers to DRR Dhan 43 unless marked "DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name)".
Note: the Seednet name DRR DHAN-47 is a separate release record in the sources; findings under that name are kept separate and are not attributed to DRR Dhan 43.
Note: 4 searches were run (the limit). A separate seed-availability search was not run; the seed finding below came from the contact search.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- DRR Dhan 43: A secondary review says IIRR developed DRR Dhan 42, 43 and 44 as drought-tolerant cultivars and released them for field trials. This is not corroborated by an IIRR release sheet, so treat it as unverified. -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Drought-tolerant-rice-varieties-released-in-different-countries-of-South-Asia_tbl4_350592747
- DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name): ICAR-IIRR lists it as heat tolerant among its high-yielding varieties. DRR Dhan 47 and DRR Dhan 52 high yielding varieties having heat tolerance. -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/?option=com_content&view=article&id=250
- DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name): A climate-resilience overview also lists it under heat tolerance during critical growth stages. -- https://issca.icrisat.org/scalable-solutions/high-yielding-climate-resilient-and-nutritious-rice-varieties
- DRR Dhan 43: No drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence evidence beyond the item above was found.

DISEASE AND PEST
- DRR Dhan 43: IIRR release summary lists resistance to brown spot, neck blast and BPH, with field tolerance to stem borer. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf (the PDF text is jumbled; the DRR Dhan 43 block sits between the DRR Dhan 42 and DRR Dhan 47 blocks, so verify against the original slide)
- DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name): IIRR summary lists resistance to blast, moderate resistance to neck blast, sheath blight, brown spot and RTD, and resistance to sheath rot, BPH and WBPH in a block that may belong to a neighbouring variety. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- DRR Dhan 43: No other disease or pest evidence was found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- DRR Dhan 43: Duration 110-115 days, long bold grain, yield potential 70-80 q/ha. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- DRR Dhan 43: Described as an early-duration, high-yielding variety suited to transplanted and direct-seeded aerobic cultivation with good weed competitiveness. This conflicts with the "long bold" grain type above, which should be checked against the official release notification. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name): Duration 115-120 days, short bold grain, yield about 60 q/ha transplanted and about 43 q/ha aerobic. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- No field-trial or multi-location yield data specific to DRR Dhan 43 was found.

GENETICS AND QTL
- No evidence found. The only QTL-linked IIRR results (qDTY2.2 and qDTY4.1) refer to DRR Dhan 42, a different variety, and were discarded. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- Parentage: not found for either name.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- DRR Dhan 43: Developed by ICAR-IIRR (formerly DRR/AICRIP), Rajendranagar, Hyderabad. The breeder's name was not found. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name): Institution-level attribution to IIRR only; no breeder name found. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- IIRR history: Originally the All India Coordinated Rice Improvement Project (1965), then the Directorate of Rice Research (1983), then IIRR (2014). -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/about-iirr/about-iirr

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500 030, India. -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us
- Director email: director.iirr@icar.gov.in. -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us
- Phone: Tel 91-40-24591285; Fax 91-40-24591217; PD Cell 91-40-24591218; Administration 91-40-24591257/256. -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/contact-us
- Institute general contact on the About page: 040-24591241, iirricar@gmail.com (a Gmail address, not an official ICAR domain). -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/about-iirr/about-iirr
- Director named as Dr. Raman Meenakshi Sundaram (Director/Project Coordinator). -- https://sarr.co.in/home/contact-us/ (Wikipedia also names him: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Institute_of_Rice_Research). The third-party listing (https://www.indiacustomercare.com/indian-institute-rice-research-icar-contact-no-040-24591281) gives a mobile number and other staff emails, but it is not an official source; verify before use.
- No breeder or scientist contact for DRR Dhan 43 was found.

PUBLICATIONS
- No evidence found. Searches returned papers on DRR Dhan 58, Pusa 44 and other varieties, which were discarded. -- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/

SEED AVAILABILITY
- DRR Dhan 43: IIRR invited registered seed growers and companies to produce its seed in 2022, listed as a 2015 release for irrigated early conditions. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK or dealer listings were found, because a dedicated seed search was not run.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- DRR Dhan 43: Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karnataka and Kerala. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- DRR Dhan 47 (Seednet name): Haryana, Gujarat and Odisha. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- Release year: the CSC record gives 2014-10-20, while the IIRR seed-production notice lists 2015 for DRR Dhan 43. The mismatch should be checked against the official gazette notification.

drought.details: The IIRR industry slide describes DRR Dhan 45 as drought tolerant, but the slide does not tie this claim to a trial result. The ICAR listing gives no drought tolerance for DRR Dhan 45 and describes it for irrigated conditions. Drought statements found in the results concern DRR dhan 50, a different variety, and are excluded.

heat.details: Not found in searched sources. The ICAR listing gives no heat tolerance for DRR Dhan 45.

salinity.details: Not found in searched sources. The ICAR listing gives no salinity tolerance for DRR Dhan 45.

flood.details: Not found in searched sources. The ICAR listing gives no flood tolerance for DRR Dhan 45.

disease_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant to blast, sheath rot and rice tungro virus (ICAR listing). Moderate resistance to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot and bacterial blight, with sheath rot resistance noted (IIRR industry slide).

pest_resistance.summary: Resistance to brown planthopper (BPH) and whitebacked planthopper (WBPH) noted, and moderate resistance to plant hoppers (IIRR industry slide). Resistance to gall midge and rice thrips, and moderate resistance to plant hoppers, recorded in an IIRR seed-production table. This table row is ambiguous and may describe a neighbouring variety.

agronomic_details.yield: Yield potential reported as 5-6 t/ha (IIRR technology profile) and about 50 q/ha (IIRR industry slide; Krishi Jagran). Units are reported as Kg/Ha in the input data field, which is empty.
agronomic_details.stability: Multi-location AICRP biofortification trials in 2013-14 were conducted in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Yield advantages over checks were reported (see field_trials). No stability statistics across environments were found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Irrigated conditions (ICAR listing). Recommended for Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. The Telangana addition in Krishi Jagran is secondary and not in the CSC-preferred list. A Bihar and Chhattisgarh listing in an IIRR seed-production table is flagged as a possible parsing error.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: 125 days (ICAR listing and IIRR industry slide); about 130 days (IIRR technology profile and Krishi Jagran). The sources disagree.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf, non-lodging, long slender-grain variety (ICAR listing). Grain zinc about 22.6 ppm overall in polished rice (24.0 ppm in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu); amylose about 20.7% (ICAR listing). Intermediate amylose 21.1%, intermediate alkali spreading value (ASV) 3.5 and gel consistency 54 mm (IIRR technology profile). Pedigree: IR 73707-45-3-2-3 / IR 77080-B-34-3 (IIRR technology profile).
agronomic_details.field_trials: AICRP biofortification multi-location trials (2013-14) in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh reported yield advantages of 37.1% over Samba Mahsuri and 17.2% over IR 64. In Andhra Pradesh alone, margins were 8.3% over Samba Mahsuri and 15.5% over IR 64. A cost-of-cultivation comparison with Samba Mahsuri on sample farms in the 2017 rainy season found similar production cost per tonne. The IIRR slide describes the variety as high yielding and early, but does not give a trial result for these claims.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources. No marker or QTL study specific to DRR Dhan 45 was found. The variety was developed by conventional breeding using HarvestPlus material.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: DRR Dhan 45 (variety_name) / DRR DHAN 57 (seednet_variety_name), rice

Naming note: All evidence below refers to DRR Dhan 45 (IET 23832). The only DRR DHAN 57 hit was a list entry on the IIRR homepage, with no details, so no evidence on the Seednet name was found. Four searches were run (the maximum allowed), and the Seednet portal was not reached. Findings are paraphrased and attributed by URL.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Described as a semi-dwarf, non-lodging, long slender-grain variety for irrigated conditions; no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance is listed for DRR Dhan 45 itself -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341
- The IIRR industry slide describes it as high yielding, early, and drought tolerant, but the same slide does not clearly tie that claim to a trial result -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- Drought-tolerance statements elsewhere in the results concern DRR dhan 50 (a different variety), so they are excluded here -- https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s44489-026-00037-w

DISEASE AND PEST
- Moderately resistant to blast, sheath rot and rice tungro virus -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341
- Moderate resistance to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot and bacterial blight; sheath rot, BPH and WBPH resistance noted -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- Resistance to gall midge and rice thrips, and moderate resistance to plant hoppers, recorded in a seed-production table -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf (this table row is ambiguous; it may describe a neighbouring variety)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Duration: 125 days (ICAR and IIRR slide) versus about 130 days (IIRR profile and Krishi Jagran); the two sources disagree -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341 ; https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed/33-iirr-technologies/106-technology-4 ; https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/list-of-biofortified-rice-varieties-a-closer-look-at-nutrient-rich-options/
- Yield potential: 5-6 t/ha (IIRR profile), about 50 q/ha (IIRR slide), 50 q/ha (Krishi Jagran) -- same URLs as above
- AICRP biofortification multi-location trials in 2013-14 reported yield advantages over Samba Mahsuri (37.1%) and IR 64 (17.2%) in TN, KA and AP; in AP alone the margins were 8.3% and 15.5% -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed/33-iirr-technologies/106-technology-4
- Grain zinc about 22.6 ppm overall (24.0 ppm in AP, KA and TN) in polished rice; amylose about 20.7% -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341
- Intermediate amylose (21.1%), intermediate ASV (3.5) and gel consistency 54 mm reported -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed/33-iirr-technologies/106-technology-4
- Cost-of-cultivation comparison with Samba Mahsuri on sample farms in the 2017 rainy season found similar production cost per tonne -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Cost-of-cultivation-and-returns-from-Samba-Mahsuri-and-DRR-Dhan-45_tbl2_338280336

GENETICS AND QTL
- Pedigree: IR 73707-45-3-2-3 / IR 77080-B-34-3 -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed/33-iirr-technologies/106-technology-4
- Developed by conventional breeding using HarvestPlus material; no marker or QTL study specific to DRR Dhan 45 was found -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341
- Parentage was "Not specified" in the input; the pedigree above comes from the IIRR profile
- Release-year discrepancy: 2015 (input, IIRR profile) versus 2016 (Krishi Jagran; IIRR seed announcement table) -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/list-of-biofortified-rice-varieties-a-closer-look-at-nutrient-rich-options/

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developed by ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Rajendranagar, Hyderabad -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341
- Breeder or scientist names: none found for DRR Dhan 45 in these results. A name appears in an IIRR slide URL (Dr L.V. Subba Rao), but the slide does not state he is the breeder, so it is not recorded as a breeder -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- Context: the institute was elevated from the Directorate of Rice Research to a national institute in December 2014 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/351749037_Rice_breeding_in_India_eight_decades_of_journey_towards_enhancing_the_genetic_gain_for_yield_nutritional_quality_and_commodity_value

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-500030 (Telangana) -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341
- Address variant: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad – 500 030 -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Official email, phone, or institute contact page URL: not found in these results. Institute homepage to check: https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/

PUBLICATIONS
- ICAR-IIRR (2023). 58th Annual Rice Group Meeting (ARGM) Final Draft Proceedings. ICAR-IIRR report (authors not listed in the extract) -- https://icar-iirr.org/58%20ARGM%20Final%20Draft%20Proceedings15-09-2023.pdf
- Authors not confirmed (year not confirmed). An economic analysis of biofortified rice varieties. ResearchGate entry (cost data for DRR Dhan 45 vs Samba Mahsuri, 2017 season) -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Cost-of-cultivation-and-returns-from-Samba-Mahsuri-and-DRR-Dhan-45_tbl2_338280336
- Abdul Fiyaz R et al. (year not confirmed). Rice breeding in India: eight decades of journey towards enhancing the genetic gain for yield, nutritional quality, and commodity value. Review that cites the release of DRR Dhan 45 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/351749037_Rice_breeding_in_India_eight_decades_of_journey_towards_enhancing_the_genetic_gain_for_yield_nutritional_quality_and_commodity_value
- No peer-reviewed paper, KrishiKosh thesis, or DOI specific to DRR Dhan 45 was found in these searches.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- IIRR seed-production call for expressions of intent (2022) lists DRR Dhan 45 among varieties for seed production -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Odisha farmer and FPO seed-training article (2025) mentions DRR dhan 45 as a specialty variety for seed production; it names no seed seller -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/ag-tech-research-news/enhancing-decentralized-seed-production-of-healthier-rice-in-odisha/
- No NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or private dealer listing was found. Seednet was not reached, so the Seednet listing (under DRR DHAN 57) remains unverified.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh (ICAR listing) -- https://icar.org.in/en/node/8341 ; https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- Telangana added (Krishi Jagran; treated as secondary) -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/list-of-biofortified-rice-varieties-a-closer-look-at-nutrient-rich-options/
- Conflict: the IIRR seed-announcement table lists DRR Dhan 45 under Bihar (Zone III) and Chhattisgarh (Zone V), which may be a table-parsing error; this needs checking against the CSC notification -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf

flood.details: No evidence found for flood tolerance in DRR Dhan 53.

disease_resistance.summary: Bacterial blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae): resistant. The variety carries Xa21, xa13, xa5 and Xa38 (per the release-notice and CSC-linked records). The IIRR slide deck describes it as highly resistant to bacterial blight, but the slide text is interleaved with other varieties, so this claim is treated with caution. The release notice and riceportal describe it as suited to bacterial blight endemic areas where susceptible Samba Mahsuri types are grown. No other disease scores were confirmed for DRR Dhan 53. Scores for leaf blast and neck blast belong to DRR Dhan 57 (IET 26171) and were excluded.

pest_resistance.summary: Not found in searched sources. The digest states no separate pest or disease scores were confirmed for DRR Dhan 53 beyond bacterial blight. Pest resistance scores (planthoppers, whorl maggot, gall midge, rice thrips) belong to DRR Dhan 57 (IET 26171) and were excluded.

agronomic_details.yield: Average yield 5.50 t/ha (release notice); range 5.5-6 t/ha (seed-to-seed record). Units in the original data are listed as Kg/Ha; equivalent to 5,500 kg/ha on average.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Suited to bacterial blight endemic areas where susceptible Samba Mahsuri types are grown. Recommended states: Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Jharkhand, Odisha, Bihar, Gujarat. Ecology and agro-climatic detail beyond the state list: Not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf, non-lodging habit. Medium-slender grain. Long, fully exerted panicles with 100% exertion. Grain quality comparable to recurrent parent Improved Samba Mahsuri; the record is labelled 'low GI'. Head rice recovery conflicts between sources: 58.4% in the release notice and 78.7% on riceportal; the conflict is unresolved.
agronomic_details.field_trials: No trial-specific results for DRR Dhan 53 were found beyond the average yield of 5.50 t/ha reported in the release notice and the 5.5-6 t/ha range in the seed-to-seed record. Mean yield of 4782 kg/ha and 13-17% yield advantage over checks in Zones III and V belong to DRR Dhan 57 (IET 26171) and were excluded.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources. Resistance genes are listed as Xa21, xa13, xa5 and Xa38; no SSR, SNP or marker positions were found.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: Not found in searched sources.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: Bacterial blight resistance conferred by Xa21, xa13, xa5 and Xa38. Developed through marker-assisted selection (MAS) from Improved Samba Mahsuri. Parentage: Improved Samba Mahsuri*3/PAU 3554 (recurrent parent Improved Samba Mahsuri). Used as a parent in a cross ('DRR Dhan 53 x IRRI-162') in the IIRR 2023 annual report; the snippet is partial and the cross details could not be confirmed further.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: DRR Dhan 53 (CSC release name; IET 27294) / DRR DHAN 57 (Seednet name)
Name note: The release-minute name "DRR Dhan 53" is the variety these findings describe. The Seednet name "DRR DHAN 57" matched a different entry, DRR Dhan 57 (IET 26171, an aerobic variety released for Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh). Those DRR Dhan 57 findings are labelled below and must not be attributed to DRR Dhan 53. No search result confirmed a Seednet listing for DRR Dhan 53.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- DRR Dhan 53 is a bacterial blight resistant variety carrying Xa21, xa13, xa5 and Xa38, with semi-dwarf, non-lodging habit -- https://krishi.icar.gov.in/jspui/handle/123456789/71147 ; https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties
- The IIRR slide deck describes DRR Dhan 53 as highly resistant to bacterial blight. The slide text is interleaved with other varieties, so any other resistance claims there are unreliable -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- No evidence found for drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance in DRR Dhan 53. The salinity and drought results that came up belong to DRR Dhan 58, DRR Dhan 42/44 and other entries and were discarded.
- [DRR Dhan 57, IET 26171, Seednet-name entry] Aerobic variety with moderate resistance to leaf blast and neck blast -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382617803_DRR_Dhan_70-IET_29415_-_An_Aerobic_Rice_Variety

DISEASE AND PEST
- DRR Dhan 53 is described as resistant to bacterial blight; no separate pest or disease scores were confirmed beyond this -- https://krishi.icar.gov.in/jspui/handle/123456789/71147
- [DRR Dhan 57, IET 26171] Moderate resistance to leaf blast, neck blast, planthoppers and whorl maggot, and resistance to gall midge and rice thrips -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382617803_DRR_Dhan_70-IET_29415_-_An_Aerobic_Rice_Variety

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Seed-to-seed maturity 130-135 days; average yield 5.5-6 t/ha -- https://krishi.icar.gov.in/jspui/handle/123456789/71147
- Average yield 5.50 t/ha; medium-slender grain; long, fully exerted panicles; 100% exertion -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties
- Grain quality is comparable to recurrent parent Improved Samba Mahsuri, and the variety is suited to bacterial blight endemic areas where susceptible Samba Mahsuri types are grown -- http://www.riceportal.in/content/drr-dhan-53
- Head rice recovery is reported as 58.4% in the release notice and 78.7% on riceportal; the two sources conflict -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties ; http://www.riceportal.in/content/drr-dhan-53
- Its record is labelled "low GI" -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed
- [DRR Dhan 57, IET 26171] Mean yield 4782 kg/ha, 13-17% above checks in Zones III and V; 120 days duration -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382617803_DRR_Dhan_70-IET_29415_-_An_Aerobic_Rice_Variety

GENETICS AND QTL
- Marker-assisted selection derivative of Improved Samba Mahsuri; cross Improved Samba Mahsuri*3/PAU 3554; parentage is therefore available and should replace "Not specified" -- https://krishi.icar.gov.in/jspui/handle/123456789/71147 ; https://www.researchgate.net/publication/365736796_DRR_Dhan_53_RP-6113-Patho-BB9_IET_27294_-_a_high_yielding_bacterial_blight_resistant_fine_grain_type_rice_variety
- Used as a parent in a cross ("DRR Dhan 53 x IRRI-162") in the IIRR 2023 annual report; the snippet is partial -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf
- [DRR Dhan 57, IET 26171] Developed from a BPT5204/Azucena cross -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382617803_DRR_Dhan_70-IET_29415_-_An_Aerobic_Rice_Variety

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION

Dilip and Kuldeep Singh (Director, ICAR-NBPGR) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/365736796_DRR_Dhan_53_RP-6113-Patho-BB9_IET_27294_-_a_high_yielding_bacterial_blight_resistant_fine_grain_type_rice_variety

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. The release notice gives no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance for DRR Dhan 56 (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)

DISEASE AND PEST
DRR Dhan 56 is reported as resistant to leaf blast, neck blast, gall midge and rice thrips, and moderately resistant to planthoppers and stem borer (-- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties?Itemid=101)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
DRR Dhan 56 (IET 26803) is an early-duration, tall, erect, non-lodging, non-shattering variety. It flowers in about 89 days, is about 102 cm tall, and has long panicles and good biomass (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)
Head rice recovery is 64.1% and intermediate amylose is 23.15% (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)
The notice does not give a yield figure for DRR Dhan 56. Its 5.50 t/ha average yield and 130–135 day maturity are for a different variety in the same notice, so they are not attributed here (-- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties?Itemid=101)
Release: notified through the Central Sub-committee on Crop Standards, Notification and Release of Varieties, S.O. 500(E) (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)
Name check: all DRR Dhan 56 evidence uses the CSC name. No page was found for the Seednet name "DRR Dhan 57", so the Seednet record could not be checked.

GENETICS AND QTL
Parentage: the release notice gives the cross Huang-Hua-Zhan*2/Phalguna, which conflicts with the "Not specified" entry in the record. The variety was bred under the Green Super Rice (GSR) Phase III project with IRRI (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)
No QTL or marker study naming DRR Dhan 56 was found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developing institution: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Hyderabad, which announced the release (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)
Lead breeder name: No evidence found. The release notice names only the Director, Dr Raman Meenakshi Sundaram, and does not identify the breeder.

CONTACT DETAILS
Institute: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Hyderabad (institute website: https://www.icar-iirr.org). No official email, phone or postal address was found in the search results. The institute home page was not opened, so its contact page was not verified.
Director named in the release notice: Dr Raman Meenakshi Sundaram, Director, ICAR-IIRR (-- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties)

PUBLICATIONS
No evidence found. The searches returned no peer-reviewed paper, AICRP/ICAR report, KrishiKosh thesis or conference paper on DRR Dhan 56. A DRR Dhan 58 salinity paper (Rice journal, https://thericejournal.springeropen.com/articles/10.1186/s12284-022-00591-3) was excluded because it concerns a different variety.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing for DRR Dhan 56 or DRR Dhan 57 was returned. The search limit was reached before a dedicated seed query could run.

RECOMMENDED STATES
No evidence found for Punjab or Haryana. The release notice gives zone-level recommendations only for DRR Dhan 54 and DRR Dhan 55, not for DRR Dhan 56 (-- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties?Itemid=101)

LIMITATIONS
The web_search tool hit its usage limit during the run, so searches were not all completed as planned. Four searches ran: the first batch failed on the limit, and the later four covered variety, breeder/contact, research and parentage. No separate seed-availability search ran.

This is an inference from the release description, not a measured drought score. The release summary also describes aerobic cultivation in water-limiting areas of several zones. Aerobic yield is reported at about 43 q/ha (see agronomic_performance). The digest's own assessment is that this reflects adaptation rather than a measured drought rating, so the level is rated medium on that basis only.

pest_resistance.summary: Reported as resistant to gall midge and rice thrips, with moderate resistance to planthoppers and stem borer (Telangana Today release item).

agronomic_details.yield: About 60 q/ha under transplanted conditions and about 43 q/ha under aerobic conditions (ICAR-IIRR 2022 notice). The IIRR group news item reports 5.50 t/ha average yield, but it covers the four-variety group and is not explicitly about DRR Dhan 54, so it is excluded.
agronomic_details.stability: Ranked top overall in AICRIP aerobic trials in 2015, 2016 and 2018. Yield advantage over the best check: about 17% (2015), 12% (2016) and 15.8% (2018). Stability across environments beyond these trial years: Not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Aerobic, dry direct-seeded cultivation in water-limiting areas. The release zones are described as Zone II (Haryana), Zone III (Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand), Zone VI (Gujarat) and Zone VII (Telangana). The IIRR notice names only Haryana, Gujarat and Odisha, so the full six-state list should be verified before reliance. Transplanted cultivation is also indicated by the 60 q/ha figure.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: 115-120 days (ICAR-IIRR 2022 notice). A conflicting figure of 130-135 days in the IIRR group news item is excluded because it covers the four-variety group and is not specific to DRR Dhan 54.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Short bold grain (ICAR-IIRR 2022 notice). Other morphological characteristics: Not found in searched sources.
agronomic_details.field_trials: Tested in AICRIP aerobic trials 2015-2018. Ranked top overall in 2015, 2016 and 2018. Yield advantage over the best check variety: about 17% (2015), 12% (2016) and 15.8% (2018). No further trial data found in searched sources.

agronomic_performance.stability: Ranked top overall in AICRIP aerobic trials in 2015, 2016 and 2018. Yield advantage over the best check: about 17% (2015), 12% (2016) and 15.8% (2018). Stability across environments beyond these trial years: Not found in searched sources.

The release zones are described as Zone II (Haryana), Zone III (Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand), Zone VI (Gujarat) and Zone VII (Telangana). The IIRR notice names only Haryana, Gujarat and Odisha, so the full six-state list should be verified before reliance. Transplanted cultivation is also indicated by the 60 q/ha figure.

agronomic_performance.field_trials: Tested in AICRIP aerobic trials 2015-2018. Ranked top overall in 2015, 2016 and 2018. Yield advantage over the best check variety: about 17% (2015), 12% (2016) and 15.8% (2018). No further trial data found in searched sources.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: DRR Dhan 54 (variety_name) / DRR DHAN 57 (seednet_variety_name), rice

SEARCH COVERAGE NOTE: Only 2 web searches returned results. A batch of five queries failed with "Server tool use limit exceeded," and the retry was limited to the breeder/contact query. The minimum of 3 searches was not met. Topic 3 (research and publications) was not separately searched, and topic 4 (seed availability) was not searched. The "DRR Dhan 57" Seednet name was not searched on its own. Findings below come from the two successful searches only. Under the strict relevance rule, the Seednet name "DRR DHAN 57" had no matching evidence in these results.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Released for aerobic, dry direct-seeded cultivation in water-limiting areas, which indicates adaptation to water scarcity rather than a measured drought score -- https://telanganatoday.com/icar-iirr-releases-four-new-rice-varieties
- Released for aerobic cultivation in water-limiting areas of several zones, per the release summary -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/
- No salinity, flood, submergence or heat tolerance data found

DISEASE AND PEST
- Reported as resistant to leaf blast, neck blast, gall midge and rice thrips, with moderate resistance to planthoppers and stem borer -- https://telanganatoday.com/icar-iirr-releases-four-new-rice-varieties
- Bacterial blight resistance is described for the four-variety release group (DRR Dhan 53–56), not specifically for DRR Dhan 54 -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties?Itemid=101

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Duration 115–120 days; short bold grain; yield potential about 60 q/ha transplanted and about 43 q/ha aerobic -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Seed-to-seed maturity of 130–135 days and average yield 5.50 t/ha are given in an IIRR news item that covers the four-variety group, so it may not refer to DRR Dhan 54 alone. This conflicts with the 115–120 day figure -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties?Itemid=101
- Tested in AICRIP aerobic trials 2015–2018 and ranked top overall in 2015, 2016 and 2018 -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/
- Yield advantage over the best check variety: about 17% (2015), 12% (2016), 15.8% (2018) -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/

GENETICS AND QTL
- No QTL or marker study found
- Pedigree reported as a cross of RP 5124-11-4-3-2-1 with IR 78877-208-B-1-1. The record lists parentage as "Not specified," so this should be checked against a primary source -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR-IIRR), Rajendranagar, Hyderabad -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/
- Release was through the Central Sub-committee on Crop Standards, Notification and Release of Varieties (S.O. 500(E)) -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article/11-news/147-icar-iirr-released-four-new-rice-varieties?Itemid=101
- Lead breeder name: No evidence found

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad – 500 030 -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Email: director.iirr@icar.gov.in; Phone: +91-40-24591218 -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Corresponding-author email on the third-party article: jyothirishik@gmail.com. Not an official ICAR address, and it was not verified as belonging to a named breeder -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/
- Institute homepage: https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not stated in retrieved text (2022). DRR Dhan 54 [IET 25653 (RP 5943-421-16-1-1-B)] – A new aerobic rice variety. Website article, ICAR-IIRR affiliation -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/
- No peer-reviewed paper, AICRIP/ICAR report or KrishiKosh thesis was found, because no research search was run.

SEED AVAILABILITY

- An ICAR-IIRR 2022 expression-of-intent notice for seed production lists DRR Dhan 54 with its release states and aerobic classification. This is an institute seed-production notice, not a retail source -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Release record (the 2022 IIRR notice) lists Haryana, Gujarat and Odisha -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Release zones described as Zone II (Haryana), Zone III (Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand), Zone VI (Gujarat) and Zone VII (Telangana) -- https://sarr.co.in/2022/07/02/drr-dhan-54-iet-25653-rp-5943-421-16-1-1-b-a-new-aerobic-rice-variety/ and https://telanganatoday.com/icar-iirr-releases-four-new-rice-varieties
- The input record's list (Bihar, Odisha, Telangana, Jharkhand, Haryana, Gujarat) matches the zones above, but the IIRR notice names only three states. Verify before relying on it.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
NOTE: Name conflict. The Seednet name "DRR DHAN 58" belongs to a separate, documented IIRR variety (a Samba Mahsuri near-isogenic line). Evidence under that name is listed separately and is not treated as evidence about DRR Dhan 68. Searches returned no seednet.gov.in page and no CSC minutes entry for either name.

STRESS TOLERANCE
DRR Dhan 68: No evidence found. The searches returned no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data for DRR Dhan 68.
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name, different variety): Salinity tolerance at the seedling stage, from a Saltol QTL introgressed by marker-assisted backcrossing; the paper reports good performance in coastal saline multi-location trials in 2019 and 2020 -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9385912/

DISEASE AND PEST
DRR Dhan 68: No evidence found.
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name): Carries three bacterial blight resistance genes (Xa21, xa13, xa5) in the Samba Mahsuri background -- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
DRR Dhan 68: The IIRR Annual Report 2022 lists DRR Dhan 68 in a release/recommendation table, with unlabelled columns (season BORO, grain type LS, a value of 6.56, and states AS, WB, TR). The yield value is not labelled, so it cannot be confirmed as yield -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name): Reported a 24% yield advantage over its recurrent parent under coastal saline conditions in multi-location trials -- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/
Maturity for DRR Dhan 68: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL
DRR Dhan 68: The annual report table gives a parentage-like string, HHZ5-DT20-DT2-Huang-Hua-105, beside DRR Dhan 68. The column header is not recovered, so this cannot be confirmed as pedigree. Input parentage is "Not specified." -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name): Marker-assisted backcrossing with five Saltol markers and three bacterial blight genes; the selected line recovered 95.3% of the recurrent parent genome at BC3F2 -- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35976520/
Not attributed: BRRI dhan99 (Bangladesh) salinity studies (e.g., https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pone.0294573). The variety_code "BRRI Dhan 99" appears near DRR Dhan 68 in the IIRR table, but no source links the two, so these studies are excluded.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
DRR Dhan 68: No lead breeder or scientist name found. The developing institution is ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR-IIRR), per the input record and the IIRR Annual Report 2022 table -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name): Developed at ICAR-IIRR, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad, with the Department of Biotechnology as the affiliation of the lead team -- https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/ Named authors include G. Rekha, V. Abhilash Kumar, P. Senguttuvel and R. M. Sundaram. These are authors of the DRR Dhan 58 paper, not confirmed breeders of DRR Dhan 68.

CONTACT DETAILS
DRR Dhan 68: No evidence found for an email, phone, breeder contact or institute contact page.
Institute-level (ICAR-IIRR): Director Dr. R M Sundaram (named as publisher of the 2022 annual report); postal location Rajendranagar, Hyderabad -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf and https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9385912/ No institute email or phone was retrieved.

PUBLICATIONS
DRR Dhan 68: No evidence found for a dedicated paper.
Rekha G, Abhilash Kumar V, Gokulan C. G., et al. (2022). DRR Dhan 58, a Seedling Stage Salinity Tolerant NIL of Improved Samba Mahsuri Shows Superior Performance in Multi-location Trials. Rice (Springer). -- https://thericejournal.springeropen.com/articles/10.1186/s12284-022-00591-3 / DOI 10.1186/s12284-022-00591-3 (Seednet name; not confirmed as DRR Dhan 68)
Sundaram R. M., et al. (2022). IIRR Annual Report 2022. ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
No KrishiKosh thesis, AICRIP report entry, or QTL/marker study for DRR Dhan 68 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
DRR Dhan 68: No evidence found from NSC, state corporations, KVKs, SAU sales or private dealers.
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name): The IIRR seed portal lists a DRR Dhan 58 page marked out of stock, with a 135-day duration -- https://iirr-seedportal.in/ NRDC has invited seed companies to take a technology licence for DRR Dhan 58 -- https://www.nrdcindia.com/LatestDetail/130

RECOMMENDED STATES
DRR Dhan 68: Table entry reads "AS, WB, TR," which matches the input states Assam, West Bengal and Tripura -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf Gazette or CSC notification not found.
DRR Dhan 58 (Seednet name): The IIRR expression-of-intent document lists different states (Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Gujarat, Maharashtra). These do not match the DRR Dhan 68 record -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
NAME NOTE: CSC name "DRR Dhan 69" appears only in the IIRR Annual Report 2022 table. Seednet name "DRR DHAN 59" matches a different IIRR entry (Xa33, BB resistant). I could not confirm they are the same variety, so the DRR Dhan 59 findings below are labelled as such. Four searches were run: variety, Seednet name, breeder/institute, and research. No separate seed-availability search was run because the 4-search cap was reached.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- No evidence found for DRR Dhan 69 (either name). The search returned pages on DRR Dhan 58, 65 and 55, which are other varieties and are excluded. -- https://www.icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/institute-research/institue-technologies-developed?id=243 (excluded, other variety)

DISEASE AND PEST
- DRR Dhan 59 (Seednet name; identity with DRR Dhan 69 unverified): DRR Dhan 59 is described as high-yielding, bacterial blight resistant, with a long bold grain type. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- DRR Dhan 59 (Seednet name): an IIRR presentation lists the entry as carrying Xa33 and moderate resistance to leaf blast and neck blast. The slide layout is ambiguous, so this line may belong to the neighbouring entry. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf
- DRR Dhan 69: No evidence found for disease or pest reaction.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- DRR Dhan 69: The IIRR Annual Report 2022 lists it in a table row reading "19 · DRR Dhan 69 · BR 8631-12-3-5-P2 · BR 7166-5B-5/ · 118 · BORO · LS · 6.85 · AS, WB, TR". The column labels are not printed, so the 118 (duration in days), Boro season, LS (long slender grain), 6.85 (yield, t/ha) and state codes are my reading, not confirmed. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
- DRR Dhan 69: No field-trial or multi-location result found beyond that table row.

GENETICS AND QTL
- DRR Dhan 69: No evidence found.
- DRR Dhan 59 (Seednet name): the Xa33 bacterial blight resistance gene is noted for this entry. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Industry_meet_ppt_Dr_LVSubbaRao.pdf

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- DRR Dhan 69: No breeder name found in any result. The only institutional link is the IIRR Annual Report 2022 table row. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
- Institution: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
- Excluded: the breeder named for DRR Dhan 100 (Kamla), a different variety, is not attributed to DRR Dhan 69. -- https://icar-iirr.org/index.php/en/component/content/article?id=282&Itemid=258

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute address: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad – 500 030. -- https://icar-iirr.org/Announcement_for_inviting_EXPRESSION_OF_INTENT_for_seedproduction_2022.pdf
- Director named as publisher of the 2022 annual report: Dr. R M Sundaram, Director, ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2022.pdf
- Email and phone: No evidence found for DRR Dhan 69 or the institute in the results.

PUBLICATIONS
- Sundaram, R. M. (2022). ICAR-IIRR Annual Report

drought.details: DRR Dhan 59 is a drought tolerant rice variety that was developed to be suitable for irrigated conditions. It has been screened for drought stress tolerance and is associated with the abiotic stress responsive gene LOC_. Os06g10210 (OsCHI2).

heat.details: The variety exhibits heat stress tolerance and was included in screenings for this trait. Candidate genes for heat tolerance have been identified in rice through combined GWAS and transcriptome analysis, which includes DRR Dhan 59.

salinity.details: DRR Dhan 59 is a salinity tolerant variety, specifically at the seedling stage, possessing the Saltol gene/QTL. Its salinity tolerance has been identified and quantified through salt stress studies.

flood.level: Not explicitly specified as distinct from submergence tolerance
flood.details: The provided search results primarily discuss 'submergence tolerance' in rice, which refers to the plant's ability to withstand being covered by water, typically caused by flooding. No distinct flood tolerance mechanism separate from submergence tolerance is detailed.

disease_resistance.summary: DRR Dhan 59 is resistant to Bacterial Blight, largely due to the presence of the Xa33 gene. It has also been indicated as a Blast resistant rice variety.

pest_resistance.summary: Specific pest resistance levels or traits for DRR Dhan 59 are not detailed in the provided search results.

agronomic_details.yield: DRR Dhan 59 is described as a 'high yielding' variety, though specific quantitative yield data (e.g., in q/ha) is not provided in the search results.
agronomic_details.stability: Information on its yield stability across diverse environments is not specified.
agronomic_details.adaptation: The variety is suitable for irrigated and medium ecology conditions.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: It is characterized as a fine grain type.
agronomic_details.field_trials: DRR Dhan 59 has been included in the 59th Annual Rice Group Meetings (ARGM) proceedings for screening and evaluation, indicating its participation in multi-location trials.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Key genetic markers identified in DRR Dhan 59 include Xa33 for Bacterial Blight resistance, Sub1 for seedling stage submergence tolerance, Saltol for seedling stage salinity tolerance, and qDTY2.1+qDTY3 for reproductive stage submergence tolerance. A novel abiotic stress responsive gene LOC_. Os06g10210 (OsCHI2) is also associated with its drought tolerance.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: Xa33 is a gene providing resistance to bacterial blight. Sub1 is a QTL conferring seedling stage submergence tolerance. Saltol is a gene/QTL providing seedling stage salinity tolerance. qDTY2.1 and qDTY3 are QTLs associated with reproductive stage submergence tolerance.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: DRR Dhan 59 was developed using advanced breeding approaches, including Marker Assisted Selection/Breeding (MAS/MABB) and genomics-assisted breeding, facilitating the introgression of target genes/QTLs for various stress tolerances.

drought.details: DRR Dhan 60 is a drought-tolerant rice variety (Result 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 12, 16, 18, 20, 32, 34, 44, 49). It is suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions (Result 8, 20). It is an improved version of Improved Samba Mahsuri, showing tolerance to low soil (Result 3, 12, 44) and specifically low soil phosphorus (Result 18, 29, 36, 47). Its drought tolerance is associated with the introgression of the Pup1 QTL (Result 5, 11, 23, 33, 40, 47).

heat.details: DRR Dhan 60 is being screened and is associated with research on heat stress tolerance (Result 7, 13, 15, 17, 19, 25, 45). Scientists at ICAR-IIRR are involved in developing varieties with heat stress tolerance, including DRR Dhan 60 (Result 14).

salinity.details: DRR Dhan 60 has been developed with the introgression of the Saltol QTL for salinity tolerance (Result 11, 22, 25, 27, 30, 45), specifically demonstrating seedling stage salinity tolerance (Result 25, 45). It is suitable for salt-affected rice growing areas, such as those in Gujarat (Result 28), and is described as salinity tolerant (Result 14, 23, 26, 29, 30).

flood.details: While DRR Dhan 60 is mentioned in the context of developing 'Multiple Stress Tolerant Varieties for Flood' (Result 32) and 'submergence tolerance' (Result 7, 15, 33, 38, 50), direct and explicit information on its specific tolerance level to general flood conditions (e.g., stagnant water beyond submergence) is not detailed.

disease_resistance.summary: DRR Dhan 60 is resistant to bacterial blight (Result 4, 9, 10, 13, 18, 19, 23, 24, 25, 29, 35, 40, 43, 45, 47). This resistance is conferred by the introgression of the Xa21, xa13, and xa5 genes (Result 4, 5, 10, 13, 19, 23, 24, 25, 33, 35, 40, 43, 45, 47).

pest_resistance.summary: Not Specified

agronomic_details.yield: Described as a high yielding variety (Result 5, 21, 23).
agronomic_details.stability: Not specified
agronomic_details.adaptation: Suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions (Result 8, 20) and medium-low soil (Result 1, 22, 34). It is also well-adapted to areas with low soil phosphorus (Result 3, 12, 18, 29, 36, 44, 47) and salt-affected areas (Result 28).
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Non-Basmati (Result 8, 20, 28, 37).
agronomic_details.field_trials: DRR Dhan 60 has been evaluated in national programs, as indicated by its inclusion in the 'Draft proceedings of 59 Annual Rice Group Meetings' by AICRIP (Result 7, 15, 26, 38, 42).

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Key genetic markers introgressed into DRR Dhan 60 include: Xa21, xa13, and xa5 for bacterial blight resistance (Result 4, 5, 10, 13, 19, 23, 24, 25, 33, 35, 40, 43, 45, 47); Pup1 (Phosphorus-uptake 1) for drought tolerance and high phosphorus use efficiency/tolerance to low soil phosphorus (Result 5, 6, 11, 16, 23, 33, 36, 39, 40, 41, 47); and Saltol QTL for salinity tolerance (Result 11, 22, 25, 27, 30, 45). The Sub1 gene is associated with its seedling stage submergence tolerance (Result 33, 50).
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: The primary QTLs associated with DRR Dhan 60 are: Pup1 (drought tolerance, phosphorus use efficiency, low soil phosphorus tolerance), Saltol (salinity tolerance), and Xa21+xa13+xa5 (bacterial blight resistance). The Sub1 gene confers seedling stage submergence tolerance.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: DRR Dhan 60 has been developed using Marker Assisted Selection (MAS) and Marker Assisted Breeding (MABB) approaches (Result 9, 14, 32, 36, 43, 47), indicating precise introgression of target genes/QTLs for multiple stress tolerance.
